name: @headstartwp/parity-audit
description: Dev-only baseline for the html-react-parser parity audit. Deliberately NOT a workspace (the root globs are packages/*, projects/*, wp/*, test-projects/* — this is packages/core/parity) so the old parser version never enters the monorepo's dependency graph or the published package. Install with --legacy-peer-deps: html-react-parser@3 peers react <=18 and the repo runs React 19, which is exactly the incompatibility the audit exists to retire.
